scope: Independent, read-only, original-resolution technical-art inspection of the four frozen Phase4 v11 PPMs produced before dispatch stopped at ordinal4. The first three machine-PASS images are comparison controls only; the broadcast machine-FAILED image is the blocking subject. This addendum neither infers a targeted11 machine pass nor authorizes capture, technical-art acceptance, or formal68.

review_method.lossless_view_note: Temporary byte-faithful PNG views and unscaled crops were used only because the review UI does not decode P6 PPM directly; all bindings, coordinates, measurements, and decisions refer to the original PPM bytes.
review_method.comparison_method: Inspect each full frame first, then the projected-trajectory pixels at 1:1. Compare actual solid-core unique area, predicted dash/gap and actual-in-gap evidence, endpoint/ticks, local silhouette contrast, and same-axis/cross-track behavior.

ordinal_comparison.finding: At player-low scale the yellow predicted core, narrow dark rim, actual solid/ticks, and terminal marks remain traceable along the long co-axial route. This visual control does not constitute targeted11 or formal acceptance.

At elevated scale the projected yellow route stays dominant while actual solid/tick evidence remains independently legible through the overlap. This is a comparison control, not inherited TA acceptance.
The overhead view preserves the yellow predicted identity, repeated gap/tick rhythm, and actual-track anchors on the co-axial vertical route. This is a comparison control only.

The oblique yellow predicted route remains the dominant readable path and the actual endpoint/two ticks remain visible, but only half of actual-source probes survive. The remaining actual pixels read as isolated white/dark fragments beside or inside the predicted compound rather than a continuously traceable actual trajectory.

actual_surviving_anchor_facts.interpretation: The endpoint and two ticks are readable anchors but cannot substitute for the missing unique actual core and all three actual solid-in-predicted-gap samples.

ownership_integrity_controls.interpretation: No cross-track ownership swap, double assignment, or unowned evidence is present. The failure is visual same-axis survival/readability, not a cross-track association defect.

canonical_axis_decisions.finding: The broadcast route retains a continuous, dominant yellow predicted identity comparable to the three controls.
Actual coverage falls from 100% in all three controls to 6/12 in broadcast; three core samples disappear and the residual actual pixels do not form an independently traceable trajectory.

Predicted yellow and its narrow rim remain separable, but actual core survival collapses at three sampled positions, so both tracks' core/halo roles are not independently readable through the oblique compound.

Two predicted outer-silhouette samples on teal cloth measure 3.9028463506845466 and 3.9970607697890235, below the unchanged 4.0 local-contrast boundary, with two additional outer-halo owned-area failures.

The yellow predicted dash rhythm itself remains visible, but all three actual solid-in-predicted-dash-gap samples fail unique owned area; the gaps no longer reliably expose actual-versus-predicted role separation.
The actual endpoint and both actual ticks remain attached and legible, as do the predicted terminal and center marker; these anchors do not repair the missing intervening actual trajectory.

Along the oblique same-axis overlap, predicted remains traceable but actual becomes intermittent. Zero foreign-track, double-assignment, and unowned counts show cross-track integrity is preserved while visual co-axial disambiguation fails.

future_visual_constraints_only: A future broadcast capture must make the actual solid core independently traceable through the full projected overlap at original 1920x1080, not merely preserve isolated endpoint or tick anchors.
Actual solid evidence inside predicted dash gaps must remain visibly actual while each predicted gap remains perceptually open.
The predicted yellow primary identity and the readable endpoint/tick anchors seen in v11 must not regress.
The final outer silhouette must meet the unchanged local-contrast requirement on teal and every other frozen stress adjacency.
Same-axis visual disambiguation must improve without introducing foreign-track, double-assignment, unowned, detached, or cross-swapped evidence.
This addendum does not prescribe implementation, relax thresholds, change route/offset/z-order/camera/layout, or authorize a recapture.

acceptance.reentry_note: Only a separately authorized future run with a complete fresh 11/11 machine pass and subsequent independent full-set TA review could change these acceptance fields.
